text: {"rules":[{"id":"HDP-SCREEN-PREG","version":"September 2023","title":"Screening for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy with blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for hypertensive disorders in pregnant persons with blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy.","grade":"B","effective_date":"September 2023","action":"Measure blood pressure throughout pregnancy to screen for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy","denominator":"{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"pregnant persons\", \"note\": \"Pregnancy during the measurement year; the topic limits this to asymptomatic persons, which is not encoded (see coverage_notes).\"}","numerator":"{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"blood pressure measurements spread across the pregnancy period, which requires pregnancy start and end dates and prenatal visit history\"}, \"quote\": \"blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy\", \"note\": \"A single in-year bp reading would not establish measurement throughout pregnancy, so this is not approximated.\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The topic limits this to 'asymptomatic pregnant persons'. Symptom status is not reliably held in structured EHR data, so it is not encoded in the denominator. A human reviewer should decide whether patients with diagnosed hypertensive disorders should be excluded; the text does not state any exclusion.","The numerator 'throughout pregnancy' depends on pregnancy start and end dates and the timing of measurements across the pregnancy. This cannot be expressed with measurement-year windows, so it is encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated with a single bp reading.","The section does not specify how often to measure, which instruments or thresholds to use for a positive screen, or what follow-up to do; none of these are represented.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('September 2023 *') whose footnote meaning is not given in this section and is not represented."]}
